presentation.speaker: sunny_adeyemi
presentation.title: Solar panel shortage
lines: A shipment of panels is stuck. Pay a premium supplier for an allocation, or wait and absorb the higher materials price.

choices.label: Pay Helio a premium allocation fee
choices.outcome: Materials stay about 10% higher for three weeks.

choices.label: Wait for the shipment and pay the shortage price
choices.outcome: Materials cost 35% more, easing over six weeks.
